chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel, from Zurara and Muhammad Bin Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The women do not inherit anything from the realty of the land.
ai.seo_question: Do women inherit from real estate in Shia Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) articulates the principle of 'al-‘aqar la waritha laha' (real estate has no heir for women), a key ruling in Shia jurisprudence distinguishing immovable property from other assets. It reflects the specific application of inheritance laws where women are excluded from inheriting land, a view supported by the interpretation of Quranic verses in light of prophetic practice. This ruling underscores the distinct financial responsibilities and shares allocated to genders within the Shia legal framework.
